protocol.metric: Current MPC-window mean ADD of the incumbent candidate, aligned by simulation time.
protocol.aggregation: Within each one-minute elapsed-time bin, average recorded errors per task, then average tasks equally. Only tasks with measurements in that bin contribute.
protocol.time: Recorded elapsed optimization time, including logging overhead.
protocol.scope: Completed traces only. No full-task error reconstruction, best-so-far envelope, zero-time imputation, or extrapolation after completion.
protocol.comparability: SPIDER window ADD and Codex full-task object-path-aligned ADD have different scopes and are not directly comparable.
